description: List the get_data query types by category, with date presets and a schema summary. Filter by category or contains, with detail='full', for a type's filters, output fields, orderBy columns and time units.

category.description: Narrow the query catalog to this analytics category.

detail.description: 'summary' returns descriptions only; 'full' adds each type's allowedFilters, outputFields, orderBy columns and timeUnits, and needs category or contains.

include.description: Sections to include. Default: hints, datePresets, schemaSummary, queryTypeNames. queryTypes adds every type's description.

name: capabilities

outputSchema.description: schemaSummary describes analytics storage; datePresets and dateFormat describe ranges; maxLimit caps rows. queryTypeNames lists query keys by category; queryTypes maps query keys to descriptions and, at full detail, allowedFilters, outputFields, orderBy columns and timeUnits. traitContract gives the trait:<key> filter rules for every listed type with a traitSubject. hints gives usage guidance; note says when a request was narrowed.

title: List query types
